name: How do I choose the right windows for my home's style?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right windows for my home's style?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right windows involves considering your home's architectural style, your aesthetic preferences, and functional needs. For traditional homes, wood or wood-clad windows with grids can maintain classic appeal, while modern homes often benefit from sleek aluminum or fiberglass frames with larger glass areas. Consider frame color, hardware, and grid patterns. A reputable contractor can help you navigate options and recommend styles that complement your home's design while meeting your performance requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's architectural style, aesthetic preferences, and functional needs. Your contractor can help select frame materials, colors, and grid patterns that complement your design.
